svg.aria-label: Architecture: PatentsView tables are reduced by DuckDB to small CSVs and built into one Relate file. Web views, the predictor and your own agent query it; sealed per-year capsules serve forecaster agents over read-only MCP; agents write forecasts into a shared ledger file, one transaction per forecast, and a grader writes the outcomes back.
